title: tidy-up: miscellaneous
body:
- add more `manually bumped` comments.
  Follow-up to b783adf8cf706f0c1c1a50f0812ad10de888dcb3 #23271
- add link to Circle CI runner image page.
- 'zero byte'/'binary 0'/'NUL' → 'NUL byte' for consistency.
- appveyor: use long-form options, `--out-null`, add `--disable`.
- whitespace/typo/comment fixes.
